title: Data Supplement for 'Dynamic induction control for mitigation of wake-induced power losses: a wind tunnel study under different inflow conditions'

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: whole control setting across turbines and downstream sections

calibration_burden: Source-native lidar-derived uu grids; grid cells are correlated interpolated products. Raw vlos retained upstream. Rotor-equivalent wind and virtual turbine power are excluded as targets and predictors. No cubic-power identity is counted as a rule. ABL Type II only.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: Geometry and actuation settings only; no reserved velocity or rotor-equivalent speed is a predictor.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Transfer is restricted to the declared source and cohort; no measured deployment intervention.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.
Resolve each stated measurement/information restriction with source-bound evidence.
Demonstrate a nondegenerate task with grouping adequate for its explicitly claimed transfer; retain limited scope if the present data cannot do this.
